The '''Temple Ruins''' was the name given to an area on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It encompassed a number of ruins surrounding the larger [[Temple of Sacrifice]]. By the time of the [[Galactic War]], the ruins were controlled by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] who had built a [[Massassi village|village]] in the area. During the [[Revanite crisis]], the [[Yavin Coalition]] [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|assaulted]] the Temple Ruins to get access to the Temple of Sacrifice.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Temple Ruins appears as an area on Yavin 4 in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
